verdict.rationale: Proa's own build tooling surfaces problems at build time: the template macro validates at compile time, props are compile-time-checked, WCAG/WAI-ARIA defects fail `cargo build`, and `--deny warnings` flags specific performance problems. None of the evidence shows what these messages look like or whether they are clear and actionable, and nothing covers dev-server runtime error output. missing for 10: evidence of error message clarity and actionability (examples, suggested fixes, source locations), dev-server error overlay or runtime error reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
